confidence_flags: several perimeter tie-beam positions in the small east bay (ซักล้าง/laundry, east of grid 3) and the two ramp-threshold beams (BX) could not be pinned to an exact printed offset — see per-element flags and warnings
warnings: Two interior secondary beams — B1 (splits rooms into north/south halves in two different locations: inside the 1-2 x B-C bathroom cluster, and again inside the 2-3 x A-B bedroom-2/laundry cluster) and B2 (splits the 1-2 x B-C room into east/west halves) — have no printed dimension anywhere in the structural set locating their exact offset from the main grid; only their existence, mark and rebar spec (S-09) are given. A faint unlabeled CAD construction line runs through the B2 location that LOOKS visually close to the midpoint of the 1-2 bay, but nothing on the sheet actually dimensions it, so per '§4 pos_m always read from a printed dimension line — never guessed' both are recorded below with span_source:'unresolved' and an approximate grid_ref, matching the precedent set by house #07's B2 interior beam. Do not treat the visual midpoint as a confirmed position.

The mark 'B5' is used twice at genuinely different locations: the north perimeter tie beam (A2-A3, 4.00m) and the south ramp/deck edge beam (C'1-C'3, 8.00m). This is printed twice on the sheet, not a transcription duplicate.

The small bay east of grid 3 (the 'ซักล้าง'/laundry room, per A-04 architecture, viewed only for context) is framed with its own tie beams (B3X, B5A, B5B) running close to and parallel with the main grid-3 line (B4X). Their exact offset east of grid 3 is not independently dimensioned on this sheet beyond the shared 1.50m module used everywhere else on the drawing (matching dummy grid 3' from the roof-level ring beam) — recorded here using grid 3' by analogy by re-using the module, at reduced confidence, rather than inventing an unrelated number. Whether the bay's inner (B3X) and outer (B5A/B5B) beams occupy genuinely different x-positions or are a double-line drafting convention for one wall could not be resolved with confidence from the plan view alone.

'BX' (ramp/entry threshold beam, per its own tapered/level-step cross-section on S-10) appears at both the west ramp zone (near B6/B6X) and a symmetric position on the east side of row C. Its exact plan position within each 1.50m taper zone is not clearly dimensioned separately from B6X's own run — recorded with span_source:'unresolved' at both occurrences rather than forcing a precise but unconfirmed grid_ref_start/end.
'SI'/'S1' and similar slab-marker confusion was checked per §10 — this sheet's markers read clearly as S0/S1/S2/S3 (digits), no ambiguity found.

Slab markers S3 (the smallest, most numerous zone type — ramp support strip, small bathroom/utility rooms, and the small east bay) are merged into one element_id per §0.1/§4 with approximate per-room grid_refs, since each is a room-area marker, not a true single point.
